name: 02-payments-phonepe-gpay-paytm
statusMessage: Done: PhonePe vs Google Pay, Paytm. 3 opportunities, 3 threats, 5 named issues. Open the Output tab for the battlecard.
verdict: PhonePe's 8.8% negative share trails Paytm's 5.4% and Google Pay's 7%, so fix bugs and support before competing on features.
issues: App not working, gets stuck on open
Charges fees on transactions without clear disclosure
No customer support or reachable complaint channel
UPI Lite failing with technical error, money stuck
Autopay debits without permission, refund wanted
